excerpt: The detector cavity lies under the peak of Mt. Ikenoyama, with 1000 m of rock, or 2700 m-water-equivalent (m.w.e.) mean overburden, at geographic coordinates 36 25' 32.6" N, 137 18' 37.1" E, and altitude 370 m above the conventional (WGS-84) geodetic ellipsoid, as determined by a GPS survey.
publisher: Super-Kamiokande Collaboration / Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A 501 (2003) 418-462
title: The Super-Kamiokande detector
